_comment: Toolchain profiles (readiness.py). Each profile: description, optional extends (a base profile), tools {name: {min, version_args, provision}}. provision names an official download: {version, url (https zip/tar, {version} substituted), checksum (sha256/sha512 hex) or checksum_url (the channel's sums file), bin (the executable's path in the archive)}. Add or override profiles in the user file $MINERVA_AGENT_PROFILES (Minerva: agent-profiles.json in its data directory); a user profile replaces a shipped one of the same name.

default.description: The agent image's toolchain: Godot, Python, Node, Go, Rust and the tools a session shell uses.

godot-4.7.description: The default toolchain with Godot 4.7, which projects declaring config/features 4.7 need. Provisioned into the session from the official Godot release when the image's Godot is older.
